purpose: Generate three compact V9-only art-derived emotion-decoration sources. They compose over the unchanged daily Rig face and never generate or replace a face.
composition_contract: Every native 200x200 preview uses a locked V9 daily Rig base and keeps eye, brow, nose and mouth source pixels above the decoration layer.
Same-state presence is deterministic: highlight lead, brow answer, mouth/cheek settle, then an optional small decoration beat.
Cross-state bridges use highlight lead, brow answer, lower-face reply and only then the target decoration; no full-face swap or crossfade.
A decoration is state context, never the primary emotional signal or a text/UI label.
source_gate: Each source sheet has exactly three separated poses with no face, body, text, label, border, UI panel, grayscale, color or texture.
At native 200x200, every overlay remains in its declared safe box and does not obscure primary facial masks.
Each three-beat motion is readable with labels hidden and has a distinct semantic grammar: question is curious/puzzled, exclamation is alert, cloud is sleepy/dreaming.
A failed source becomes audit-only and cannot be used as visual input, component export, CRIG binding or firmware asset.

internal_triage.reason: At native 200x200 the curious question competed with the inherited daily sparkle, the alert stem degraded into an unbalanced thin mark, and the dream cloud competed with the inherited sleep moon-and-Z charm. The source shapes are audit-only and must not be used as visual reference, component export, CRIG binding or firmware art.
